ingredients.heading: Ingredients
ingredients.mergeDescription: Fold {{name}} into another ingredient. Every recipe using it is repointed automatically — nothing is lost, and {{name}} is removed from the catalog. This can't be undone.
ingredients.noTranslationsLong: No translations added. Provide multiple languages to standardize your database.
ingredients.seasonalityNoData: — no data (won't affect the gallery's seasonality filter)
ingredients.waitForCategories: Please wait for categories to load or create one.

ingredients.categoryModalSubtitle: Categories group the catalog and colour its cards.
ingredients.sectionClassificationHint: How this ingredient is grouped, filtered and searched.
ingredients.sectionNamingHint: Alternate names make it findable; translations give it a name per language.
ingredients.autoTranslateHint: Leave translations empty and the AI will fill them in from the English name when you save.
ingredients.tidySubtitle: English name, general → specific → variation, a name per language
ingredients.tidyIntro: The AI reviews every ingredient: it renames it to the catalog convention (English, e.g. "Apple" → "Renetta Apple" → "Renetta Apple Slices"), links each specific ingredient to its general one, and fills the languages that are missing. Existing translations are never overwritten. You review every change before it is applied.
ingredients.tidyNothing: Everything already follows the convention — nothing to change.
ingredients.tidyDuplicate: Would become "{{name}}", which already exists — use Merge to combine them.

import.title: Smart Import
import.subtitle: Paste a link or raw recipe notes. Our Culinary AI will transform it into a perfectly formatted masterpiece.
import.fileHintSuffix: file exported from another SmartChef instance — a single recipe, a bulk export, or a whole collection. Ingredients and tools it needs are matched against your library or created automatically.
import.findingMatches: Finding matching ingredients, tools, and techniques…
import.notSureFormat: Not sure how to format it? Use the template — fill it in here, or copy it out to write the recipe elsewhere and paste it back later. Text in the template's shape (or JSON) is recognized and processed instantly, no AI needed.
import.rawTextPlaceholder:
Mom's Famous Lasagna
Prep time: 20 mins, Cook: 45 mins.
Serves 6.

Ingredients:
- 1 lb ground beef
- 1 jar marinara sauce
- ...

Instructions:
1. Brown the beef.
2. Layer with noodles and sauce.
...
import.pasteToPreview: Paste a recipe URL or raw text and start the transformation to see a preview here.
import.localModelNote: This runs on a local model with no GPU acceleration — it can take several minutes.
import.notValidJson: That file is not valid JSON.
import.rawTextTemplate:
Title:
Description:
Language: [it / en / fr / es]
Servings:
Prep time: [e.g. 20 minutes]
Cook time: [e.g. 45 minutes]
Rest time: [e.g. 30 minutes — leave blank if not applicable]
Difficulty: [easy / medium / hard / expert]
Tags: [comma-separated, e.g. vegetarian, quick, italian]
Tools: [comma-separated, e.g. oven, stand mixer, blender]

Ingredients:
- [quantity] [unit] [ingredient name] ([optional note, e.g. "finely chopped"])
- 200 g flour
- 2 eggs
- 1 tsp salt

Steps:
1. [First step]
2. [Second step]
3. 

Storage: [optional]
Tips: [optional]
import.jsonTemplateHint: JSON carries a little more than the text form: ingredient groups, and a title and duration per step.
import.noAiNeeded: Recognized as a SmartChef template — imported directly, no AI involved.
import.rawTextTemplateJson:
{
  "title": "",
  "description": "",
  "language": "it",
  "servings": 4,
  "prepTimeMin": 20,
  "cookTimeMin": 45,
  "restTimeMin": null,
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "tags": ["vegetarian", "quick"],
  "tools": ["oven", "blender"],
  "storageInstructions": "",
  "tips": "",
  "ingredients": [
    { "name": "flour", "quantity": 200, "unit": "g", "notes": "sifted", "groupName": "For the dough" },
    { "name": "eggs", "quantity": 2, "unit": null, "notes": null, "groupName": null }
  ],
  "steps": [
    { "stepNumber": 1, "title": "Make the dough", "description": "Mix the flour and eggs.", "durationMin": 10 },
    { "stepNumber": 2, "title": null, "description": "Rest in the fridge.", "durationMin": 30 }
  ]
}
import.migrationMatched: {{matched}} of {{total}} ingredient names matched to your library automatically.
import.migrationSkipped: {{count}} entries could not be read and will be skipped.
import.migrationDone: Imported {{created}} recipes and created {{ingredients}} new ingredients.
import.noCategory: Create at least one ingredient category first.
import.scanHint: A photo of a recipe page, a PDF, a voice note or a cooking clip. Read the text on this device, or hand the whole file to your AI provider.
import.chooseScan: Choose a photo, PDF, audio file or video
import.scanPdfNoText: That PDF has no text in it — it looks like a scan. Export the page as an image and try that instead.
import.scanOcrCaveat: PDFs with real text are read instantly. Photos use on-device text recognition, which downloads a ~{{mb}} MB language model the first time and then works offline. Printed pages read well; handwriting is hit and miss, so always check the result.
import.scanAiHint: Sends the file itself to your AI provider, so it can hear a voice note or watch a clip — not just read printed text. Which file types work depends on the provider: Gemini takes images, PDFs, audio and video; Anthropic takes images and PDFs; OpenAI and Ollama take images (Ollama needs a vision model).
import.scanOcrOnlyForText: On-device reading works on photos and PDFs. For audio or video, use “Analyse with AI”.
import.matchLanguageHint: Ingredients, tools and techniques below are matched against your library in this language. Change it if the suggestions look wrong.
import.langUnsupported: This recipe looks like it's written in {{lang}}, which SmartChef doesn't have a catalogue language for. Pick the language to match and store it in — names are kept exactly as written either way.
import.searchNoResults: Nothing in your library matches that.
import.namingBusy: Asking the AI for the catalog name and translations…
import.translatedOnCreate: Translations will be generated by the AI when created.

converter.title: Converter
converter.subtitle: For the two things the recipe cannot know: your oven and your tins.
converter.outsideGasRange: Outside the range gas marks cover.
converter.tinHint: Scale by area, not diameter — a 23 cm tin holds about a third more than a 20 cm one, not 15% more.
converter.tinResult: About {{pct}}% {{direction}} mixture ({{a}} cm² → {{b}} cm²). Multiply every ingredient by this.

share.title: Share this recipe
share.subtitle: Anyone with the link can read this one recipe.
share.explain: Creates a link that shows just this recipe — no account needed to open it. Nothing else in your library is reachable from it.
share.scope: Only this recipe is visible. Who created it, your ratings and your cook log are not included.
share.reachability: The link points at your server, so whoever you send it to has to be able to reach it — on your network, or over Tailscale.
share.offlineExplain: A shareable link needs a server that stays reachable, and this device is running SmartChef offline with no server. You can send the recipe as a file instead — whoever receives it imports it into their own SmartChef.

pantry.title: Pantry
pantry.intro: Keep track of what you have, then ask what it lets you cook. Recipes are checked all the way down — if a dish uses a sauce that is itself a recipe, its ingredients are counted too.
pantry.quantityHint: Leave blank for “I have some” — that counts as enough.
pantry.cookHint: Optional ingredients never count against a recipe, and an amount that cannot be compared is assumed to be fine.
pantry.checkFailed: Could not work out what you can cook
pantry.noneCookable: Nothing matches yet — add more to the pantry, or loosen the filter.
pantry.anyMatchHint: Shows every recipe you have at least one ingredient for, best covered first.
pantry.fellBackBody: Here is what your pantry gets you closest to instead.
pantry.noneCookableAtAll: None of your recipes use anything currently in the pantry.

languages.heading: Languages
languages.subtitle: Add a language to write recipes and translations in. The interface stays in one of the four it ships with.
languages.interfaceHint: The language the app itself is written in. Stored per person, so everyone sharing this device keeps their own. Picking a language from the header moves this and the recipe language together; set it here to keep them apart.
languages.codePlaceholder: Language code, e.g. pt or pt-BR
languages.bundledHint: Ships with the app — cannot be removed
languages.note: Languages you add are stored on this device. Recipes written in them sync normally, and their names are recognised on your other devices.

sync.nothingChanged: Nothing changed — already up to date.

conflicts.heading: Needs Your Attention
conflicts.subtitle_one: {{count}} item changed differently on two devices.
conflicts.subtitle_other: {{count}} items changed differently on two devices.
conflicts.noPerRowIdentity: No per-row identity for this field, so only a count can be shown here — not a line-by-line diff. Picking one side replaces the whole list with it.
conflicts.wholeListReplaced: Picking one side replaces the whole list with it — this diff is just to help you decide, not a per-line merge.
conflicts.keepAllTheirs: Keep all of the other device's
conflicts.nothingAutoResolvable: Nothing here can be settled automatically — each one needs your choice.
conflicts.howToChoose: Tap the version to keep. Highlighted words are what differs; "newer" marks the most recent edit.
conflicts.cannotCompare: These two versions cannot be compared item by item.

folderSync.heading: Folder Sync
folderSync.subtitle: Choose how this device exchanges changes with your others — a plain synced folder, or a real git server.
folderSync.subtitleCrossRef: This is how offline devices reach each other; to move the library onto a server instead (or back off one), see "{{card}}".
folderSync.adminOnlyNote: Only an admin profile can change where this library syncs to, its credentials, or its devices.
folderSync.stalePush: This device is receiving changes but not sending them — its last successful upload was {{when}}. Anything created here since then is still only on this device.
folderSync.modeGitRemoteHint: GitHub, GitLab, or a self-hosted git server.
folderSync.repositoryUrlHint: An empty private repo works fine — GitHub, GitLab, or any self-hosted git-http server your other devices can also reach.
folderSync.corsProxyPlaceholder: Leave blank unless you have a specific reason to set one
folderSync.corsProxyHint: This app reaches GitHub/GitLab/self-hosted servers directly through native code on both Windows and Android, not the browser — so unlike most git-in-the-browser tools, no CORS proxy is needed here at all, including for GitHub/GitLab. Leave this blank.
folderSync.corsProxyToggle: + Advanced: CORS proxy (not needed for GitHub/GitLab — this app connects directly)
folderSync.automaticSyncHint: How often SmartChef checks for changes automatically, besides on app resume and "Sync Now".
folderSync.knownDevicesUnavailable: Known-devices tracking isn’t available in Git Remote mode yet — check "History" below for recent activity instead.
folderSync.nothingTransferred: Nothing to upload or download — already in sync.
folderSync.failedEntities_one: {{count}} item from other devices couldn't be saved here ({{types}}) — try Repair Local Data below.
folderSync.failedEntities_other: {{count}} items from other devices couldn't be saved here ({{types}}) — try Repair Local Data below.
folderSync.resyncAllHint: Re-serializes every recipe, ingredient, tool, tag, technique, and profile this device has and pushes them all — use after updating if something looks missing on the other end, not needed for routine syncing
folderSync.repairHint: Re-applies this device's own sync history onto its local data — fixes an item whose ingredients/steps/tools went missing after syncing, without needing anything from another device
folderSync.couldNotSaveGitRemote: Could not save git remote settings

conflictPolicy.label: When both devices change the same thing
conflictPolicy.newestHint: Like git: whatever was edited last wins. You are only asked when that can’t be told.
conflictPolicy.askHint: Every real disagreement waits for you in "Needs your attention". Obvious cases are still settled.

replace.title: Replace this device with the synced data
replace.hint: Discards this device’s library and takes the Sync Folder’s (or git remote’s) exactly — like "git reset --hard". Use it when this device has drifted and you don’t want to merge.
replace.done_one: Done: {{count}} item taken from the synced data, {{discarded}} removed from this device.
replace.done_other: Done: {{count}} items taken from the synced data, {{discarded}} removed from this device.
replace.couldNotReplace: Could not replace this device’s data
replace.confirmSubtitle: This device will match the synced library exactly.
replace.warning: Changes on this device that were never synced will be discarded, along with anything only this device has.
replace.kept: Kept: a backup of this device’s sync history, cooking history, collections, planner, shopping list and settings.

setupFile.label: Setup File
setupFile.hint: Everything on this card except the sync folder itself — the mode, the interval, and the repository URL, username and access token — in one passphrase-encrypted file, so setting up your next device doesn't mean typing a token on a phone keyboard.
setupFile.appliedNeedsFolder: — now choose this device’s sync folder above.

backup.subtitle: Download your whole library as a single file — save it wherever you like, including a cloud-synced folder. Restoring merges it back in (newest wins per item), it won't wipe anything.

profile.name: Name
profile.noPasswordHint: No password in offline mode — this device's data is already private to you. Used to label recipes you create and cooks you log.
profile.logOutHint: Back to “who’s cooking?” — pick another profile or add a new one

profiles.heading: Profiles
profiles.subtitle: Everyone who's set up a profile on this shared library.
profiles.addHint: Added as a regular user — promote them below afterward if they should be an admin. They pick this profile from “who’s cooking?” on any device sharing this library.
profiles.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Recipes and ingredients they created stay untouched — this only removes their profile from the picker.

storageMode.heading: Where your library lives
storageMode.subtitle: Admin only. Moving it copies everything across and merges it in — the side you are leaving is never emptied, so you can always switch back.
storageMode.currentOfflineHint: Local storage, optionally mirrored through a Sync Folder
storageMode.toServerHint: Sign in as an admin on the destination server. This device's library is copied up and merged in, then this device starts using the server. Its offline copy stays on disk untouched.
storageMode.photosNote: Photos stored as files on this device are referenced by path, so they will not follow the recipes up. Everything else — recipes, ingredients, tools, techniques, tags, categories — does.
storageMode.toOfflineHint: The server’s whole library is downloaded onto this device and this device switches to offline storage. Nothing is removed from the server — other devices keep using it exactly as before. You will be asked who you are (“who’s cooking?”) once it is done.
storageMode.doneOnServer: Done — this device now keeps your library on the server.
storageMode.doneOffline: Done — this device now keeps your library offline.
